q1.question: Who owns what I put in?
q1.answer: You do. From the Pro plan up you export all of it to Excel in one action, and you can leave whenever you like. We do not hold your students hostage to keep you subscribed.

q2.question: What if the internet drops mid-class?
q2.answer: The scanner keeps working and syncs when the connection comes back. WhatsApp messages queue and send once you are online again.

q3.question: How do I pay you?
q3.answer: By card, online, through Paymob. You can save your card so renewals go through on their own, and swap it whenever you like.

q4.question: Can I move plan later?
q4.answer: Yes, at any time. Move up when you outgrow your capacity, move down when you do not need it. The change lands on your next invoice and nothing is lost.

q1.question: Will my center see my private students?
q1.answer: No. Your own groups are yours alone. A center you teach at sees only the groups it runs, and never your private income.

q2.question: I only teach at centers. What do I pay?
q2.answer: Nothing, and that is not a trial. Watching your cut from the centers you teach at is free permanently. You pay only if you start running your own groups.

q3.question: Do I set my own prices?
q3.answer: You do. You set the price for each of your groups, and the invoice is written at that price. We never set it and we never take a cut of it.

q4.question: What if a student pays cash?
q4.answer: Record it in one tap, against that student and that session. It counts towards the same total as a link payment, and the receipt looks the same.
